title: EnableLooking - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to look around on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableLooking(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables looking. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable looking myLayer.EnableLooking()
; Disable looking InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableLooking(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsLookingEnabled - InputEnableLayer
